purpose: Held-out evaluation reference outcome for a widespread complete outage of a business-critical customer service where the impact is established but no directly responsible application, platform, dependency or configuration condition has been identified.

incident_summary_requirements: State that the Customer Web Portal is completely unavailable across the United Kingdom and Ireland.
State that customers cannot access the portal or complete online purchases.
Mention that all monitored portal checks failed and returned HTTP 503 responses.
State that no directly responsible technical component or failure condition has yet been identified.
Do not claim that an application, edge, storage, API, authentication, compute, database or configuration failure caused the outage.

severity.rationale: A Tier 1 business-critical customer service is completely unavailable across two national storefront regions, no successful portal use is recorded and no workaround is available. The directly observed impact is sufficient for a non-provisional Critical classification even though the technical cause remains unknown.

incident_category.rationale: The directly supported condition is complete service unavailability. No evidence supports a more specific application, infrastructure, network, dependency or configuration category, so the symptom-based category remains provisional pending technical investigation.

affected_area.rationale: The Customer Web Portal is the visible affected service. No supporting component has been directly implicated, so dependencies must not be classified as affected areas without further evidence.

routing.rationale: RG-DIGITAL owns the affected Customer Web Portal under symptom-only routing. RG-OPS coordination is required because the incident is Critical and has widespread customer and business impact.

prohibited_recommendations: restart the Customer Web Portal or any supporting component
change DNS, routing, firewall or load-balancer settings
initiate broad remediation across multiple systems
declare a specific component or technical condition to be the definitive root cause
claim that any investigative or remedial action has already been completed

information_gaps: The directly responsible technical component and failure condition.
The independently verified health of the portal's edge, storage, API and authentication dependencies.
The expected duration or recovery time for the outage.

assessment_notes: The scenario is intentionally cause-agnostic and tests whether the framework uses the bounded availability fallback rather than fabricating a technical category.
The impact evidence supports Critical severity independently of root-cause certainty.
Dependencies are contextual possibilities only and must not be listed as affected without direct evidence.
Technical ownership and Critical-incident coordination must be represented separately.

The scenario is materially distinct from the formative authentication-unavailability scenario because it concerns complete failure of the customer web channel, widespread confirmed impact and mandatory Critical coordination.
